description: fib (Fast In Balance) WebSocket echo through its websocket package: the RFC 6455 handshake and frame parser run as a connection handler on fib's edge-triggered epoll event loop, in each of the children fib's prefork package starts, one for every two CPUs with two Ps each, all listening on :8080 with SO_REUSEPORT, so each message is parsed from the buffer its loop read into and echoed with WriteMessage on that loop, with no goroutine per connection. Default configuration throughout.
